owner: Dept D Pre-registration Officer (draft for the Director; batch 1b, prescreen #6). RECOMMENDATION: do not spend the count (see notes)
hypothesis: A pre-registered hypothesis under test, not an edge claim. Schmeling and Wagner (JFQA 60(1) 2025, 36-67): a change in the tone of the ECB president's press-conference opening statement (Loughran-McDonald negative-word share) moves euro-area equity prices through a risk-premium channel, the response arises during the press-conference window 14:30-17:30 CET and is not reversed. Sign fixed in advance: LONG euro-area index CFDs after a positive tone change (fewer negative words than at the previous press conference), SHORT after a negative one, from after the statement is public to before the cash close.
rules: Events: scheduled ECB monetary-policy press conferences (the ECB 'monetary policy statement' listing, https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/press_conference/monetary-policy-statement/<year>/html/index_include.en.html, fetched 2026-11-06), English transcript page per event. Timing regime (ECB press release 2022-06-27, ecb.pr220627~73acedf868): decision 14:15 CET and press conference 14:45 CET from 2022-07-21 (13:45 / 14:30 before). Text: the opening (introductory / monetary policy) statement = transcript text before the first occurrence of 'ready to take your questions' (case-insensitive); if the phrase is absent the event is excluded (counted and listed). Tokens = maximal runs of letters A-Z/a-z, upper-cased. Lexicon frozen: Loughran-McDonald Master Dictionary, words whose Negative flag is a year in 2009..2011 (the 2011 list Schmeling-Wagner used; later additions ignored). Tone tau = 1 - N/T (N negative tokens, T all tokens). Delta tau(d) = tau(d) - tau(previous scheduled press conference, whatever its date). Side = +1 if Delta tau > 0, -1 if < 0, no trade if 0. Instruments: GRX (GER40) and FRX (FRA40); a leg trades only if its bars exist at entry and exit and it is inside its usable span (GRX excluded 2020-06-15..2023-12-01 per data/qa). Clock Europe/Berlin (= CET/CEST), applied to HistData bars whose ts is bar-open UTC (clock histdata_rule). ENTRY at the open of the 15:05 bar (20 minutes after the 14:45 start, after the statement and related documents are public; the score is computed from the posted text at that time). EXIT at the open of the 17:25 bar (before the 17:30 Xetra/Euronext closing auction; fallback first existing bar 17:26..17:28). Event P&L = mean over the traded legs of w_i * side * ln(P_i(exit)/P_i(entry)) - costs. No stops, no targets.
parameters: tone = 1 - LM(2011) negative share of the opening statement; signal = sign of the change vs the previous press conference; entry 15:05 CE(S)T; exit 17:25 CE(S)T; legs GER40 + FRA40 equal risk
instruments: FTMO GER40.cash and FRA40.cash CFDs (tested on HistData GRXEUR / FRXEUR 1m bid); EU50 not usable (HistData ETXEUR ends 2018-12-14)
holding: 2 h 20 min intraday on press-conference Thursdays (15:05 -> 17:25 CE(S)T); 8 events/yr, about 19-20 events in the decision window
data: histdata_cfd_1m_GRXEUR;histdata_cfd_1m_FRXEUR;ecb_press_conference_transcripts (to be ingested by Dept C: free HTML, reachable 2026-11-06);lm_master_dictionary (to be ingested by Dept C: sraf.nd.edu -> Google Drive link, reachable 2026-11-06)
vol_scaler: leg weight w_i = (0.10/sqrt(252)) / sigma_i, sigma_i = EWMA (centre of mass 60 sessions) s.d. of the instrument's 15:05->17:25 CE(S)T log return over all prior sessions, at least 40 observations; no cap/floor.
cost_model: 1x floors per briefs/00-common.md (index CFDs 0.5-1.5 bp per side), inherited D4-spec numbers: GER40 0.8 bp, FRA40 1.0 bp per side at entry and exit on top of the bid-to-bid return; no swap (flat intraday). 2x run attached (1.6 / 2.0 bp per side).
decision_rule: Gate v2 on the OOS window only, one read through qe.gateway.load(id,'oos'): pass iff (1) one-sided t of the net-1x per-event P&L (iid and event-level bootstrap >= 430,000 draws; the lower) >= 3.6807; (2) net-2x mean > 0; (3) criteria 4 and 7 of PARAMETERS.md (years, concentration, terciles of |Delta tau|, +-25% neighbours on entry/exit minutes, one-bar delay) pass; (4) Red Team and re-implementation sign-off; (5) hold-out read on the *_holdout datasets in the restated one-sided tolerance form with h = decay_haircut. Anything else is 'refuted' or 'near-miss'; the result file prints criterion-4 power and the joint figure for its own OOS length. Gate-1 data precondition: the transcript and dictionary ingests must be pinned (sha256) and the event list frozen in the manifest before any price read; until then the row cannot run.
notes: Source: candidates.md rank 6 (SC C-13-01), prescreen-2026-11-06 #6. Ingestibility check 2026-11-06 (structure only, no prices): ECB yearly listings 2010/2015/2019/2024 HTTP 200, each listing that year's press-conference transcript pages (is<yymmdd> links); one transcript (2019-12-12) parsed: opening statement and Q&A text present, no clock times in the page (timing comes from the ECB schedule above); LM dictionary page HTTP 200, Google Drive links redirect (download not attempted). So the data are free and ingestible; the row is drafted as instructed. EVIDENCE WINDOW (corrects candidates.md, which said 1999-2017): the journal version uses 241 press conferences Jan 1999 - Dec 2021 on EuroStoxx 50, MSCI EMU and 10 EMU country indices incl. Germany and France (open-access PDF, openaccess.city.ac.uk eprint 32436, fetched 2026-11-06, Sections II and III, Table IA.5 window 14:30-17:30). Under D-009 every euro-area index and every date to 2021-12 is derivative, so the untouched window is 2022-01..2024-12 (3.0 y); the OOS starts at the institutional change date 2022-07-21 (decision 13:45 -> 14:15, press conference 14:30 -> 14:45 CET): post-change window of 2.4 years, about 20 events, under 5 years and allowed only as post-change. GER40 is in the GRX exclusion hole until 2023-12-01, so most events have FRA40 only. UK100 (not in the evidence) was considered and rejected as a decision market: it co-moves ~0.8 with EuroStoxx on the same displayed dates, so it would be derivative in substance. Closed families: E2 (FOMC/CPI ES/NQ) adjacent - other bank, other market; not a re-run. OOS 2.4 years: bar 2.35 annual Sharpe; criterion-4 power 0.09/0.29/0.53 at true Sharpe 1.5/2.0/2.4; joint figure for < 5 years not in the PARAMETERS table (below the 5-year 0.32/0.67/0.78). Economics: prescreen 15-30 bp/event after haircut vs 1.6-2 bp round trip = 8-15x (passes). HONEST POWER: a per-event Sharpe after haircut of ~0.15 over ~20 events gives expected t ~0.7; the bar needs per-event Sharpe >= 0.82; P(pass | edge exists) ~0.002, expected passes ~0.0002. RECOMMENDATION to the Director: list as 'blocked by the derivative rule (untouched window 2.4 years, ~20 events)' and do not register; the draft exists and dry-runs so that the decision is explicit, and so that the row can be registered unchanged once 2025-2027 events extend the window (hold-out 2025-01..2026-10 adds ~14 events but is reserved under D-004). Firm clauses touched: FTMO intraday (flat 17:25 CE(S)T, same FTMO day), 5% daily loss path-wise; FTMO funded +-2 min news rule: no order within 2 minutes of the 14:15 decision or the 14:45 press-conference start (entry 15:05, exit 17:25). Futures firms: not applicable (Eurex). Family ecb-tone-equity would hold 1 of 5 counts.
